canonicalWiki.resolution: existing lib/sdd-paths.js getWikiHome(canonical registered main tree), exactly equal to this registered relative target; Git common-dir locates project identity only
canonicalWiki.rule: exactly one wiki root per project; every CLI / MCP host / worktree must resolve to it
canonicalWiki.workspaceBinding: SDD_HOME/SDD_WIKI_HOME values never register a target or confer permission. CLI result must equal the pre-registered target under the same project, without link escape. P4_4 owns the one resolver and launcher.

worktreeMapping.rule: every linked worktree resolves to the SAME canonical main-tree wiki root; a per-worktree llmwiki/ copy is never a wiki root and paths under it are uncontained by definition

hardInvariants: containment denials (traversal, symlink escape, uncontained paths) are enforced unconditionally by the resolver; the declarative flags above are records of intent — disabling a flag in this file can never weaken the resolver, and validate rejects any such mutation
identityLabels: structured receipts carry stable labels (<main-working-tree>/<root>) and booleans only; raw host paths are redacted per the house displayPath rule

revisionVerification.escapeDenial: VERIFIED-LOCAL-RUNTIME: traversal / symlink-escape / foreign-wiki-root / project-id-mismatch denials re-executed and held (allowed=false each); hard invariants held again with all policy denial flags disabled — the flags above remain records that cannot weaken the resolver
revisionVerification.worktreeConsistency: VERIFIED-LOCAL-RUNTIME: 73 git worktrees (main tree + 72 linked) all resolve to the single canonical main-tree wiki root; no per-worktree wiki root was accepted
revisionVerification.note: the registered root .sdd/wiki/sdd-harness does not yet exist on this host; the resolution authority (lib/sdd-paths.js getWikiHome + tools/mcp/llmwiki.sh) was verified to resolve to exactly this target, the landing itself is uninitialized
